description: This file defines a Drupal 6 user migration source plugin class, extending DrupalSqlBase, with methods for querying user data, preparing rows, and defining fields for migration.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A migration source plugin class for migrating Drupal 6 user data from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to select user data from the 'users' table.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields to be migrated, including roles.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row by adding roles, event timezone info, and unserializing data.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for users, which is 'uid'.

methods.name: baseFields
methods.description: Defines the base fields for user data to be migrated, with additional fields based on database schema.
